critical_code_review_comments: PilotWelcomeBanner.js:121-128 — CTA onClick correctly writes localStorage.bidvex.utm_source='pilot-welcome-banner' BEFORE navigate('/vehicle-auctions/seller/register?utm_source=pilot-welcome-banner'); confirmed live by Playwright (URL + LS both set).

SellerRegistrationPage.js:71-76 — useEffect at top of checkExisting hook reads URLSearchParams and writes utm_source to localStorage with .slice(0,100) cap; verified live with deep-link visit (cleared LS, navigated direct, LS repopulated to 'deep-link-test').
CreateVehicleListingPage.js:97-103 — useEffect parses URL utm_source FIRST (URL priority over stored value), writes to localStorage with 100-char cap.
CreateVehicleListingPage.js:367-371 — listingData.utm_source pulled from localStorage at submit time; POSTed to /api/vehicles.

CreateVehicleListingPage.js:401-428 — Post-success celebration gated on (utm_source==='pilot-welcome-banner' AND sellerProfile.total_listings===0). Triggers center + 2 side confetti bursts; bilingual EN/FR toast (i18n.language.startsWith('fr')) with 8s duration; removes localStorage.bidvex.utm_source so it fires only once. Else branch shows standard success toast. Logic matches spec exactly.

test_iter198_pilot.py — 3/3 pytest assertions pass: model accepts utm_source, license-approval auto-creates vehicle_sellers draft (seller_type=dealer, verification_status=approved, license_number/license_province/license_expiry pre-filled, monthly_listing_limit=500, auto_created_from_license=true), GET /api/admin/pilot-conversions returns total+sample with admin auth.
Backend admin endpoint /api/admin/pilot-conversions — confirmed 200 for admin, includes test-seeded listing in sample[]. The pytest test handles 429 rate-limit retry with 15s sleep (resilient).
iter196 messaging-gate (14/14) and iter197 admin counters (7/7 + 1 skip) regression: ALL GREEN.
